svg.title: Attention patterns compared
svg.desc: Four eight by eight causal grids: dense lower triangle, sliding window of width three, local band plus one global column, and a strided sparse pattern.
svg.text: Which query–key pairs are computed (n = 8 tokens, causal)
Row = query position, column = key position. Filled = computed; light grey = masked future.
Pair counts are exact for n = 8 and computed in code; the cost labels are asymptotic shapes.
